notes.title: 💨 First Animations & Soundtracks from A Story About Farting 2
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone! [/h1][p][/p][p]We’re excited to finally share some fresh progress from [i]A Story About Farting 2[/i]!
[/p][p]The very first animations of Level 1 are now ready, and we couldn’t be happier with how the Pharaoh’s chamber is coming to life. On top of that, we already have four different soundtrack tracks prepared – each setting a slightly different mood for your fart-fueled adventure (and yes, there will be more to come!).[/p][p][/p][h2][b]You can check our first animations here: [/b][/h2][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="7k-YQOhd4TI;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]

[b]And here you can check also some soundtracks :D[/b] [/h2][h2][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="92YWcAOZNYQ;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="3CM52CZKm7o;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="8WK_AvNyyq8;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="uA96Juega_o;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]From here on, the world of [i]A Story About Farting 2[/i] is only going to get bigger, funnier, and smellier. Below you’ll find a short overview of the main mechanics we’re building into the game so far.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]What’s inside the game so far?[/h2][p][/p][p]Here’s a quick look at the core mechanics we’re building into [i]A Story About Farting 2[/i]:[/p][p][/p][h3]1. Clicking & Farting[/h3][list][*][p]Each click makes the Pharaoh fart or burp while reducing the [b]Gas Bar[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If the Gas Bar fills up completely → 💥 the Pharaoh explodes in a comical animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Over time, the bar starts filling automatically, so you must keep clicking faster and faster to stay alive.[/p][/*][*][p]Every few clicks = currency called [b]Gas Drachmas[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]2. Flies = Rescue[/h3][list][*][p]Flies appear on screen – click them quickly before they escape![/p][/*][*][p]Catching one reduces gas more effectively than normal clicking.[/p][/*][*][p]Catching all flies in a round gives bonus currency, but beware: while chasing them, the Gas Bar fills dangerously fast.[/p][/*][/list][h3]3. Currency & Upgrades[/h3][p][/p][p]Earn [b]Gas Drachmas[/b] by clicking, catching flies, or completing mini-games. Spend them on ridiculous upgrades such as:[/p][list][*][p][i]Socks of Horus[/i] → extra gas reduction per click[/p][/*][*][p][i]Garlic Cauldron[/i] → auto-click every 2 seconds[/p][/*][*][p][i]Sarcophart[/i] → double click power for 5 seconds[/p][/*][*][p][i]Burp Oil[/i] → more flies appear[/p][/*][/list][p]Each with over-the-top, funny descriptions.[/p][p][/p][h3]4. Pyramid Construction[/h3][p][/p][p]Every set of clicks = progress in building a pyramid. Unlock new levels and mini-games as the pyramid rises![/p][p][/p][h3]5. Death & Restart[/h3][p][/p][p]Gas Bar full? BOOM. The Pharaoh explodes. Restart and try again – but only part of your currency survives.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]These mechanics apply only to Level 1.[/b][/u] The plan is to have at least several to a dozen levels in total, each with different gameplay and activities. Future levels will introduce puzzle elements, arcade-style challenges, RPG-inspired systems, and more.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🙌 Support Us on Patreon[/h3][p][/p][p]We’re sharing behind-the-scenes content, more animations, and exclusive details with our [url="https://www.patreon.com/c/LizardGamessStudio"]supporters on Patreon.[/url]
[/p][p]Every bit of help keeps this fart-fueled adventure alive and gives us the chance to make [i]A Story About Farting 2[/i] bigger, crazier, and funnier.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/c/LizardGamessStudio" style="button"]Check more on our Patreon[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 💨 A Story About Farting 2 – It’s Happening! (And Yes… We Have a Teaser)
notes.content:
[h1]Hey friends,[/h1][p][/p][p]We’re beyond excited to share that [b]A Story About Farting 2[/b] is officially in development!
It’s louder, smellier, and way more ambitious than the first game — and yes, we even have a tiny [b]teaser[/b] to show you. 

[b]The fart of a deranged pigeon has drifted all the way to Ancient Egypt![/b][/p][p]That’s where the next chapter of [i]A Story About Farting[/i] will unfold — this time with much more ambition, new mechanics, and engaging gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s the story this time?[/b][/h3][p]You’ll travel back to [b]Ancient Egypt[/b], where [b]Pharaoh Tutankafart[/b] suffers under the dreadful curse of the sinister priest [b]Dungareptus[/b].[/p][p]The Pharaoh’s catastrophic gas could literally bring the entire civilization to its knees.
Only the legendary [b]Pyramid of Purification[/b] can save him… and all of Egypt.[/p][p]Expect absurd fart-powered chaos, cursed relics, roaming animals, clicker-style gameplay, and a cast of characters no one asked for — but everyone will remember.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]A father-and-son passion project[/b][/h3][p]This game is being made by [b]just two people[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Me[/b] – doing the design, sounds, and general chaos[/p][/*][*][p][b]My Dad[/b] – drawing every single character and background by hand, and coming up with some of the most unhinged ideas you’ll see in the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="Pk2OTXA0zic;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]What’s next?[/b][/h3][p]We’re currently polishing the [b]first level[/b], and we hope to show real [b]gameplay footage in August or September[/b].[/p][p]The game has the potential to grow into something huge:[/p][list][*][p]Multiple levels across Ancient Egypt[/p][/*][*][p]Weird animals and cursed NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]“Super Fart” power-ups and time challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Animated cutscenes that are as epic as they are stupid[/p][/*][/list][p]But for now…[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Our only limitation is budget[/b][/h3][p]We have the ideas, we have the passion — what we don’t have is enough money to hire [b]programmers and animators[/b] to fully bring this world to life.[/p][p]That’s why we’ve launched a [b]Patreon[/b]. Even [b]$1 of support[/b] makes a difference and helps us:[/p][list][*][p]Speed up development[/p][/*][*][p]Add new animations, characters, and levels[/p][/*][*][p]And keep this little dream alive[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]❤️ Why join our Patreon?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]As a Patron, you’ll get:[/p][list][*][p][b]Exclusive behind-the-scenes content[/b] (artwork, dev notes, and silly sketches)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early access to teasers[/b] and our development roadmap[/p][/*][*][p]The chance to [b]vote on new ideas, characters, and features[/b][/p][/*][*][p]For some tiers: the opportunity to [b]design your OWN level[/b], which could make it into the final game[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]free digital copy of [i]A Story About Farting 2[/i][/b] on launch day[/p][/*][*][p]And if you don’t already have it — a [b]free Steam key for [i]A Story About Farting 1[/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][p]This project is fueled by farts, but powered by your support 💛[/p][p]
You can help us here: [url="https://www.patreon.com/c/LizardGamessStudio/membership"]https://www.patreon.com/c/LizardGamessStudio/membership[/url] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for being here.
Thank you for checking out our humble teaser.
And thank you for helping a father and son make the weirdest dream come true.[/p][p]With love (and gas),
[b]Lizard Games Studio[/b][/p]

notes.title: 💨 Fart Harder: Update #1 Is Here! 💩
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey fart lovers, gas masters, and burp wizards!
[/b][/h2]
We’ve just dropped our first official update for A Story About Farting, and it’s full of sweet, sweet quality-of-life improvements — and by sweet, we mean violently disgusting.

[h3]🚽 What’s new?
[/h3]
💨 Faster, smoother clicking – no more fart-blocking animations (except when unlocking achievements). 

💨 Full mute option – you can now mute all game sounds in the settings.

💨 Resolution settings – customize your game resolution.

💨 Rooster bug fixed – At 3,000 clicks, your poultry pal should now scream music properly.

💨 Autoclickers welcome – we removed the EULA rule about autoclickers. Cheating? Nah. Empowered farting. Do what you want, we love it.

💨 New gross sounds – we've added a few freshly recorded burps and farts to spice up the atmosphere. You're welcome.

[h2]💭 What’s next?
[/h2]
We're just getting warmed up (gas builds slowly):

🎮 Mini-Game Incoming – In 1–2 weeks, you’ll unlock a special fart-powered mini-game once you get Fatty to unleash a super fart.

🗺️ New map + mechanics – A whole new environment is coming, complete with bizarre new features.

🏆 Steam features coming soon – We’re closing in on unlocking global Steam achievements, trading cards, and more. Get ready to flex those fart stats.

[h2]🐪 A Story About Farting 2 Is in the Works!
[/h2]
🔍 Yes, you read that right. Development has started on A Story About Farting 2.
🔍 This time, the fart saga continues in... Ancient Egypt.
🔍 But this won’t be just a clicker – expect something bigger, deeper, and weirder. More details soon. 👀

[h2]🕵️‍♂️ Detective Fartwhistle – Another Game in Development!
[/h2]

🔍 We’ve finished the full script and are diving into art production.
🔍 It’s absurd, it’s mysterious, and yes — it’s gaseous.
🔍 Stay tuned, the world of Fartwhistle is coming.

💬 Join iur smelly community: https://discord.gg/Wnb7yHVaPa 

Want to hear secrets before anyone else? Or just discuss your favorite fart flavors?

Join our official Discord — it’s where the chaos begins.

And if you'd like to support our family project (and help us afford more baked beans), you can find us on Patreon. We’re endlessly grateful for every bit of help. 💗

Thanks for playing, clicking, farting, burping, and generally being amazing.

Stay gassy and classy,
~ The Fart Family Team 💨

notes.title: Click, Fart, Repeat – The Update You Deserve 💨
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone!
[/h3]
We’re currently working on fixes and updates to A Story About Farting with our entire fart-loving community in mind — and for everyone still holding one in.

[b]First up (hopefully within the next 2–3 days), we’re adding:
[/b]
💨 Option to mute in-game sounds

💨Smoother animations and faster clicking

💨Full support for autoclickers

💨 Screen resolution settings

💨Fixes for better Steam Deck performance

💨 Adjusted fart frequency + new (equally disgusting) sound effects

[b]Next up, we’re planning a gameplay overhaul:
[/b]
💨 New features that will completely change the meaning of the game and how it’s played (still in testing — a lot depends on budget, since I’m not a pro developer and will need outside help). The main goal will be to delay the explosion of the fat guy by using various mechanics.

💨A mini-game you can unlock, with an extra achievement to win

💨The cow will also fart and make sounds

💨 More interactive environment (timeframe depends on budget too)

[h3]Also:
[/h3]
💨 My dad and I are starting concept work on A Story About Farting 2

💨We’ve finished the story for a comedy-crime game called Detective Fartwhistle (this one won’t be a clicker — we’re aiming for something in the style of The Wolf Among Us)

💨 We’re sharing all the latest news on our Discord too, come hang out: https://discord.gg/Wnb7yHVaPa

💨And if you’d like to support us, you can do that through Patreon — we’ll be posting updates on Farting 2 and Detective Fartwhistle there as well.

Thanks for being here.
Stay gassy. 💨

notes.title: What's new in A Story About Farting?
notes.content:
The first major update to A Story About Farting will introduce a number of changes:

- From now on, you will be able to fart constantly - even during animations, which means you will be able to earn points faster and earn achievements faster at the same time!

- The problem with achievements not being displayed on Steam has been fixed

- The problem with the game taking too long to load has been fixed.

But that's not all!

Get ready for more news, because soon you will be able to fart with more than just one hero!
